top_results.content:
AS_152507_CV-X_UM_C81US_KA_GB_2045_5.pdf | CV-X UM_A 7-91

CV-X UM_A 7-91

Capture Using the LJ: V Series Head (CV-X400 Series Only)

Changing the Interval for Obtaining the Profiles with the LJ-V Series Head (Line Scan Settings) (CV-X482/X480LJ)

Detailed Settings (only when [Specify Encoder] is selected) -Encoder Direction:

OFF (Default): Counts both in the clockwise and counterclockwise directions.

CW: Always counts in the clockwise direction only.

CW and CCW: Counts in the clockwise direction and if there are counts in the counterclockwise direction, reverts that amount and then counts.

OFF (Default): Counts in the clockwise direction.

ON: Counts in the counterclockwise direction.

None (Default): Does not use the Z-phase input.

Trigger: Uses the Z-phase input as trigger input.

Reset Pulse Count: Uses the Z-phase input as reset for the encoder count.

Reset Pulse Count and Trigger: Uses the Z-phase input as reset for the encoder count and as trigger input.

Trigger: Uses the external trigger as trigger input.

Reset Pulse Count and Trigger: Uses the external trigger as reset for the encoder count and as trigger input.

-Detect Timeout: Sets the time to timeout from when the encoder count is interrupted.(Unit: ms)
